name: buyer.search.favourites
title: Profile: buyer.search.favourites
description: Canonical buyer query profile for the current actor's favourited listings.
text:
# buyer.search.favourites

TL;DR:
- Use this profile for favourite-only buyer search.
- The canonical filter is filter.isFavourite = true.

This profile is for browsing listings that the current actor saved as favourites.
whenToUse: The user wants saved or favourited listings.
The workflow is about favourites rather than general browsing.
recommended: Optionally add category or delivery constraints if the user wants a narrower favourite subset.
avoid: Do not infer favourites from listing.my or generic actor state.
Do not use this profile without authenticated buyer context.
exampleInterpretation: Returned items are favourited by the current actor.
listing.isFavourite should be true for matching results.
